src/pc_m4.c.new:
/* Eurorack: a 4 x 4 key matrix instead of GPIO buttons. Its code table at
 * 0x3001f7d8 (16 keys of 16 B: press code +0, release code +8, level +0xc,
 * 1 = up, 0 = held; checked in the simulation) holds A as press code 0x0c. */
#define PC_KEY(k) ((volatile const uint32_t *)(0x3001f7d8u+16u*(k)))
